---
title: "Future of Work EB"
link: "https://doi.org/10.2767/8591026"
link-text: "Special Eurobarometer 554: Artificial Intelligence and the future of work"
who: "European Commission (DG EMPL)"
when: "2024"
where: "EU-27"
countries: eu27
asked: "Individuals"
sample: "26,415 people aged 15+"
use: firm
use-note: "No question on the respondent's own AI use; asks about the employer's use of digital technologies, including AI"
question: "\"How positively or negatively do you perceive the use of robots and Artificial Intelligence in the workplace?\""
demographics:
  individuals: ["age", "sex", "age at end of education", "occupation (socio-professional category)", "employment status", "sector", "difficulty paying bills", "country"]
  firms: ["workplace size (reported by respondent)"]
aim: "To gauge public attitudes towards AI and digital technology in the workplace, including support for rules on how employers use them. It measures opinions rather than use."
other-topics: "Algorithmic management (hiring, task allocation, monitoring, performance evaluation, dismissal), transparency and access to one's data, employer-provided tools and training for AI, digital skills, job security and work pace."
---
